note: Document- and lineage-level identity for the Anthropic safety corpus. Lineages group documents that draw on the same underlying generative event. Hand-curated; see SUBQUESTION.md for the known limit. Keys are URLs so resolveDocumentId picks up lineage assignments.

anthropic-rsp-v3-lineage.label: Anthropic Responsible Scaling Policy v3 (Feb 2026) — including v3.1, v3.2, v3.3, v3.4 redlines
anthropic-rsp-v3-lineage.description: The single RSP document (currently v3.4 effective July 8, 2026; substantive rewrite is v3.0 effective Feb 24, 2026). Defines the four catastrophic-risk categories, the industry-wide recommendations table, the Frontier Safety Roadmap commitment, the Risk Reports, and the governance commitments (RSO, Board, LTBT). v3.1–v3.4 are redline updates that modify specific sections of v3.0; they do not redefine the lineage.

anthropic-risk-report-feb-2026-lineage.label: Anthropic Risk Report: February 2026 (redacted)
anthropic-risk-report-feb-2026-lineage.description: First Risk Report under RSP v3.0. Evaluates catastrophic risk across four categories (non-novel CBW, novel CBW, high-stakes sabotage, automated R&D) plus cross-cutting considerations. Issued May 26, 2026 (updated version). Implements the Risk Reports commitment from RSP v3.

anthropic-sabotage-risk-report-opus-4-6-.label: Anthropic Sabotage Risk Report for Claude Opus 4.6
anthropic-sabotage-risk-report-opus-4-6-.description: External-facing Sabotage Risk Report prepared for Claude Opus 4.6, published under the RSP commitment made at the launch of Claude Opus 4.5. Required by RSP v3.0 once a model crosses the AI R&D-4 capability threshold (Anthropic states Opus 4.6 does not cross that threshold).

fli-ai-safety-index-2026-summer.label: FLI AI Safety Index — Summer 2026 Edition
fli-ai-safety-index-2026-summer.description: Future of Life Institute's expert review of nine leading AI companies across 37 indicators in 6 domains. Seven expert graders (UC Berkeley, U Montreal, U Wisconsin-Madison) score Anthropic at 2.66 / 4.0 (C+), the highest in the Index. Anthropic leads five of six domains; OpenAI leads Risk Assessment.

anthropic-sabotage-risk-report-opus-4-6.title: Sabotage Risk Report for Claude Opus 4.6 (external-facing)
anthropic-sabotage-risk-report-opus-4-6.author: Anthropic
anthropic-sabotage-risk-report-opus-4-6.derivation_basis: RSP v3.0 §3 states sabotage risk reports are required for 'all future frontier models clearly exceeding Opus 4.5's capabilities' once a model approaches AI R&D-4. Anthropic published this for Claude Opus 4.6.
anthropic-sabotage-risk-report-opus-4-6.independence_note: Model-specific. Implements a specific RSP v3.0 commitment for one model. Not cited directly in this case's evidence blocks but referenced in the lineage declaration.
